summary: Implemented server-side tool result logging in llm logs. In llm/logs.py added _LogRowBuilder._output_segment_hashes to walk from tip back to parent hash and stored it as _output_message_hashes. log_row_extras now uses output hashes for tool_call ids, adds server_result_ids from _part_ids, marks each tool_call entry with server_executed, and builds tool_results by concatenating local results (False) then server results (True), each id-sourced from the matching map with server_executed placed right after exception. In llm/cli.py, annotate_log_rows strips _output_message_hashes; logs_list extracts a _display_tool_results helper, renders local results only under the prompt-section Tool results heading, and renders server results under ## Response after Tool calls and before the text. Added the Unreleased changelog bullet. All 93 tests in tests/test_llm_logs.py and tests/test_plugins.py pass.
